# Claude Code 2.1.234 identity

Frozen against installed and npm `@anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.234`.

`identity.json` and `protocol.json` record the headless axis. `response-only.json`
records the separate response-only axis. Neither replaces the
`claude-code-2.1.220` headless decoder specimen nor the `2.1.227`/`2.1.228`
response-only specimens. No provider prompt was sent.
